concepts.name: 暮色薄荷
concepts.direction: Direction 01: "01 / 暮色薄荷". An exceptionally calm charcoal-black interface continuing the existing Sofatap mint identity. Board background pale cool gray to separate dark windows. App canvas #11191B, gently lifted dark-slate central pairing card, accent pale mint #98E9C4. Sofatap header with compact glyph and status pill. Large bold but friendly rounded Chinese headline. White QR island within one generous rounded dark card, device/network line underneath, single filled mint copy-link button with very dark label. Quiet text-only bottom buttons. 16-20px corner language, subtle shadows, restrained and polished, never gamer neon.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a high-fidelity desktop UI concept comparison board for Sofatap, a native iPhone-to-computer remote receiver. This is a DESIGN PROPOSAL, not a screenshot or a website. Landscape approximately 2400x1500, straight-on perfectly flat pixels, crisp readable typography, premium realistically buildable interface.
Composition: exactly THREE complete separate desktop app windows in one horizontal row, equal width and height, generous margins and enough room for all content. Each window around 460 by 650 logical points, comfortable desktop proportions. Left labeled Windows, middle labeled macOS, right labeled Linux outside the windows. Windows has native minimize/maximize/close at upper right; macOS has native traffic lights at upper left; Linux has restrained native GTK headerbar controls at upper right. No browser tabs, address bars, monitors, phones, hands, photographs, or perspective mockups.
All three windows share the SAME content geometry, visual language, typography scale, colors and ready-to-pair state; only the real native window frame differs. These are three ports of one product, not three different UI designs. A small board heading above the row includes the concept number/name supplied below and Sofatap.
Brand must be EXACTLY "Sofatap", spelled S-o-f-a-t-a-p, one word, lowercase t. A tiny simple mint/single-accent sofa/phone/cursor glyph can accompany it, but no new elaborate mascot. Short simplified Chinese product copy, exact readable text:
Main brand: "Sofatap"
Primary instruction: "扫码，坐回沙发"
Helper: "在 iPhone 上打开 Sofatap，扫描二维码"
Status with a small green or accent dot AND text: "已就绪 · 等待 iPhone"
A large square pure-white pairing area in each window contains a crisp BLACK generic QR-like placeholder, with a small central "DEMO" interruption. It must contain no authentic pairing token, credential, IP, URL or machine identifier. Preserve a generous white quiet zone, no color/inversion or decorative distortion of QR. Below it print "示意码" in small gray text.
Device row: "客厅电脑"; adjacent or below a restrained network selector "家庭网络" with chevron.
Primary/secondary action as appropriate to style: "复制配对链接".
Footer assistance: "iPhone 与电脑连接同一 Wi-Fi"; compact private-code hint "配对码请勿分享".
Bottom controls: "刷新" and "退出".
Do NOT say already connected. Do NOT invent login, accounts, remote-desktop streaming, cloud services, Bluetooth, performance charts, subscription, sidebars, microphone, audio equalizer, a desktop touchpad or extra settings. No fake OS permission dialogs in this ready state; permission/error screens are later variants. Do not add marketing paragraphs to the app. Keep QR the central focal point, clear hierarchy, generous spacing, very few controls and accessible text contrast.
Outside the windows, add a small bottom note "AI 设计概念 · 非实际截图". No additional annotations, palette swatches or tiny technical text. All three windows must be fully visible, no overlaps, no cropping.

concepts.name: 奶油客厅
concepts.direction: Direction 02: "02 / 奶油客厅". A warm inviting daytime living-room utility, not technical-looking. Board muted oat color; app canvas warm ivory #FAF7F0, warm charcoal typography, muted sage #667C5B actions and a tiny warm apricot status accent. The layout is airy and flatter than a stack of dark cards: a friendly left-aligned brand/header, broad centered scan instruction, pristine white QR island with a very faint warm border, device/network in a quiet bottom strip. Use soft 12px rounded rectangles, lovely readable humane type, abundant cream negative space. Wide sage copy-link button. Extremely subtle paper warmth, no actual fabric texture, skeuomorphic sofa, gradients or illustrations. Feel like an inviting household appliance.

concepts.name: 清透原生
concepts.direction: Direction 03: "03 / 清透原生". The most concise native desktop utility. Near-white app canvas #F7F9FC, deep neutral typography, clear calm blue #326DD9 accent. Board light cool blue-gray. Flatter composition with thin separators and restrained system-like rectangular controls; compact header containing brand and a small textual status, clear headline with lots of breathing space. QR sits directly on a white content area without a nested decorative card or heavy shadow. Device name and network selector align as one compact form row below. System-like blue copy-link button, neutral refresh/quit. 8px moderate corners, no giant pills. Native finish while identical inner content layout across Windows/macOS/Linux. High legibility and precision, useful rather than sterile.

concepts.name: 墨色青柠
concepts.direction: Direction 04: "04 / 墨色青柠". Bold restrained editorial graphic design for a memorable utility: warm off-white board, nearly black #161817 app canvas, bone-white text, selective fresh lime #C6EE62. Strong typographic rhythm; larger left-aligned Sofatap wordmark and sharply aligned instruction block contrasted with compact metadata. Central pure-white QR square has crisp modest 6px corners and substantial breathing room; no rounded-card nesting. A thin lime rule gives an accent, small status indicator lime but body text white. Copy-link is a solid lime rectangular control with black label, precise short neutral footer actions. Confident Swiss grid, almost no shadows, no glows, no cyberpunk/gaming embellishments. Same inner content grid on all three operating systems.

concepts.name: 暮光客厅
concepts.direction: Direction 05: "05 / 暮光客厅". Refined evening living-room aesthetic: muted deep navy #171D31 canvas with one very subtle dusk-violet tonal area near the header, silver-white text and soft lavender #BCA9F3 action. Board dusty blue-gray. Quiet header brand aligned with small line icon, welcoming medium-weight headline. A single softly elevated pairing surface, large pristine white QR square with 14px corners, compact network row integrated below, lavender copy-link action. All interface text completely sharp and opaque, real native controls. Very subtle ambient lighting around the outer window only, no thick glass blur, no cosmic artwork, no heavy neon. More intimate and soft than the charcoal concept, with fewer outlined containers and a restrained rounded geometry.
